title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-31
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑octane party vibe from a brief 1968 appetizer, but the recording starts out muddy before improving.
ai_review.review: Fans describe this March ’68 fragment as a high‑energy, fast‑paced “appetizer” that captures the band’s party spirit. The sound quality is uneven – the first two tracks are described as hallway‑like with almost no speaker presence, while later material sounds noticeably better. Overall sentiment is mixed due to the strong performance but inconsistent audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews give a spread of 0‑4 stars; positive remarks about the show are offset by clear complaints about poor early recording quality, leading to an average rating in the low‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First two songs sound like a hallway with no speakers – very muffled and lacking presence. After that point the audio improves noticeably, but overall the mix is uneven.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short, appetizer‑style set that maintains a high‑octane party atmosphere throughout.
